definitions.explanation: The act of cleaning dishes, or a person who washes dishes.

examples.japanese: {食器洗|しょっきあら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食器洗|しょっきあら}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧だ。
examples.english: Washing the dishes after dinner is my job.

examples.japanese: {食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{家事|かじ}→家事：12313_kaji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧になった。
examples.english: Since we bought a dishwasher, housework has become easier.

notes:
{食器洗|しょっきあら}い is a compound of ⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧ (dishes/tableware) + {洗|あら}い (washing). Refers to the act of washing dishes or a person who washes dishes.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {食器洗|しょっきあら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to wash the dishes
- {食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き}: dishwasher (machine)
- ⟦{食洗機|しょくせんき}→食洗機：19300_shokusenki⟧: dishwasher (common abbreviation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{皿洗|さらあら}い→皿洗い：13667_saraarai⟧: dish washing (slightly more casual, literally 'plate washing')
- ⟦{洗|あら}い{物|もの}→洗い物：08171_araimono⟧: things to be washed (dishes, laundry)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese households, {食器洗|しょっきあら}い is one of the common ⟦{家事|かじ}→家事：12313_kaji⟧ (household chores). ⟦{食洗機|しょくせんき}→食洗機：19300_shokusenki⟧ (dishwashers) are becoming more popular but are still less common than in Western countries.
